shell_commands:
git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: update tool documentation to reflect input validation at registry level

Tool input is now validated against the inputSchema at ToolRegistry.execute time
before the executor runs. Update docs to remove guidance about defensive input
validation, and clarify that input reaching an executor has already been validated.
Update README, docs/adding-a-tool.md, example/weather-tool.ts, and .specify/spec.md
to consistently describe the registry-enforced validation and how executors can
rely on validated input.
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
git add .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "chore: mark documentation facet complete in dod.md"
timeout 60 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Suites|Tests:|PASS|FAIL"
